name: Kagura Douchuuki
source:
The story takes place in a deserted hot spring town. One day, the residents go missing one by one, as if spirited away... While the police investigation isn't going well, more mysterious phenomenon happen. The police decides to hire two miko to investigate the case. But they are totally different, like oil and water. Will they be able to solve the case...?

[Edited from ErogeShop]

Features random dungeon generation, the Kagura-typical defeat-ero scenes and a multiplayer mode.
translation:
故事发生在一个荒废的温泉小镇。某一天，居民们一一失踪，仿佛神神秘秘的……就在警方调查进展不顺利的同时，更神秘的现象发生了。警方决定聘请两名巫女调查此案。但它们是完全不同的，就像油和水一样。他们能否破案……？

[编辑自ErogeShop]

具有随机地牢生成、神乐典型的失败场景和多人游戏模式。
